# Generated files to skip

A file is generated — out of review scope — if it matches any of these rules.

## Path patterns

- `tests/output/**/generated/**`
- `clients/**/*Client.cs` (auto-generated C# client classes, not hand-authored ones)

## Content markers

A file whose first few lines contain a machine-generated header, including any of:

- `auto-generated` / `<auto-generated>`
- `Code generated`
- `generated by`
- `DO NOT EDIT` / `Do not edit`

## What stays in scope

Sources under `clients/<lang>/` that are materialized from `templates/` but committed by hand are in scope. Only skip files matching the patterns above.

Do not flag missing regeneration. If a template changed but generated output was not updated, that is expected and intentional.
